title: Five R Scenario Matcher
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: Match ten everyday teacher actions to the one of the five R permissions (retain, reuse, revise, remix, redistribute) that each action uses.

learningObjectives: The learner will apply the definitions of the five R permissions to name the one permission that each of 10 classroom actions exercises, with at least 8 correct on the first attempt.
prerequisites: The terms open license and the five permissions retain, reuse, revise, remix, and redistribute

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Predict, commit an answer, and read the reason
keyQuestions: Which test question does this action answer?
Is the work changed, combined, or shared as it is?
commonMisconceptions: Reuse covers any use, including after changes
Retain means keeping a link to a resource online
Revise and remix are the same permission
Sharing an unchanged copy is reuse
assessmentOpportunities: You email a colleague an unchanged copy of an open worksheet. Which permission?
You add alt text to every image in an open chapter. Which permission?
You download the editable source files of an open lab manual for safekeeping. Which permission?
What is the difference between revise and remix?

controls.name: Five permission buttons
controls.description: choose the permission the action uses.

controls.name: Next
controls.description: moves on after you read the feedback.

controls.name: Previous missed / Next missed
controls.description: on the results screen, page through the actions you missed.
